name: Annihilan Strike generates 2 Felfury on hit (#4665)
contract: Annihilan Strike's DBC description (560762 and every other rank in the 801903 chain, confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer) reads 'Generates 2 Felfury / Unleash a devastating attack, dealing X% Weapon Damage to your target with both weapons.' No mention of a kill condition anywhere in the tooltip. The ability's own effects are two SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE triggers (801913 main hand, 801914 off hand), both plain SPELL_EFFECT_WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE with no third/energize/Felfury effect on any of the 7 ranks, and no CoA script cast anything toward Felfury (800058) for this ability before this fix - an exhaustive grep of AscensionFelsworn*.cpp found zero hits for a baseline Annihilan Strike Felfury grant (the only Felfury-adjacent code touching it, the Twin Fury crit bonus, is itself the separate #4720 bug and contributes nothing on its own). The fix grants 1 Felfury per landed weapon hit (felsworn_casts::OnSpellHitResult, gated on info->Id being 801913 or 801914, the same successful-hostile-hit gate every other hit-result branch in that function uses), matching the DBC's explicit '2' with the ability's own two-weapon design - unconditional on a crit or a kill, since neither is stated in the tooltip.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: no Felfury before the cast
DISCRIMINATING: both weapon hits landing grants the DBC's 2 Felfury
